course.title: Materials Manufacturing Processes
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A cylindrical workpiece is subjected to a cold, upset forging operation. The starting piece (07) is 75 mm in height and 50 mm in diameter. It is reduced in the operation to a height of 36 mm. The work material has a flow curve defined by K=350 MPa and n=0.17. Assume a coefficient of friction of 0.1. Determine the force as the process begins and at the final height of 36 mm.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
